Kinnera Bar & Grill in the works for Herndon

Posted on September 28, 2026September 28, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

A new fine dining restaurant celebrating Indian cuisine is reportedly in the works for Herndon. It’s called Kinnera Bar & Grill.

According to its social media, Kinnera is coming to the Worldgate Centre where it will be moving into the space currently occupied by the Kapalsi Indian Cuisine restaurant.

Kinnera touts that it will specialize in South Indian cuisine – in particular the popular dish biryani.

Biryani is a long-grain rice dish with spiced meats and/or vegetables and aromatics cooked slowly together.

Right now, the new restaurant is teasing its opening saying it is “coming soon” and “the wait is almost over” – but no firm date has been announced yet.
